The '''Ywllandr system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Prefsbelt sector/Legends|Prefsbelt sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
It was used as a chokepoint by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the latter stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

A [[Battle of the Ywllandr system|battle]] occurred here during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], during which [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] led a [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] strike force against the Separatists from aboard the [[Courageous (Republic flagship)|''Courageous'']].
